title: Implement framed authenticated command/result transport over the recovered named-pipe session
sourceBackedBasis: LWB-R7-097 command/call and result wire envelopes
LWB-R7-099 queue, byte-budget and I/O timeout limits
LWB-R7-115 authenticated hello and route admission
LWB-R7-119 pending-call/result registry and exact 200 ms generic Lua-call timeout

implementation.sessionStreamOwnership: one non-owning NamedPipeServerStream per accepted native server handle, reused from hello through RPC
implementation.outbound: pending call -> recovered command/call JSON -> 4-byte little-endian framed write
implementation.inbound: full common envelope validation -> result/heartbeat dispatch
implementation.resultCorrelation: payload.id into host-global pending registry bound to authenticated profileId + instanceId
implementation.outerRequestIdEquality: deliberately not asserted because R7-097 did not recover that validation
implementation.unknownLateResult: ignored/unmatched rather than fabricated as a pending completion

regressionProof.isolatedAcceptLoop: PASS after shared duplex stream ownership change
regressionProof.isolatedHandshake: PASS after shared duplex stream ownership change

implementationFindingsDuringProof.finding: A second async FileStream over the same overlapped native pipe handle cannot re-bind that handle to the .NET thread pool.
implementationFindingsDuringProof.resolution: Accepted session now owns one long-lived stream reused from handshake through RPC.

implementationFindingsDuringProof.finding: A single generic FileStream strategy serialized a long-lived read against writes and prevented duplex RPC traffic.
implementationFindingsDuringProof.resolution: The accepted native handle is wrapped once in NamedPipeServerStream(InOut,isAsync=true,isConnected=true), preserving native CreateNamedPipeW ownership while allowing concurrent reader/writer loops.

implementationFindingsDuringProof.finding: StopAsync cancellation initially escaped through the inbound channel loop.
implementationFindingsDuringProof.resolution: RunAsync treats host-initiated cancellation as ordinary termination while preserving propagation of the primary non-cancellation loop fault.

nextExactGap: Compose the shared listener, accepted-session RPC transport and call registry into LWBridgeControlPipeHostState; start that host before Overview profile launch, enable the already-tested launch binding only while the host is active, and stop/drain it on application shutdown. Keep WebView call_lua fail-closed until get_status.pending is sourced from this live registry and only getStatus is explicitly allowlisted.
